metadata.title: Datshi | Bhutanese recipe
metadata.description:
This is a very simple Datsi recipe that I learnt from a Bhutanese friend during my stay at hostel in Chennai. This was quick and easy way of preparing this dish with minimal ingredients and was handy, on days when the hostel food was not that great. 
Ingredients 
1 small block of cheese – about (100 gms or more)
2 medium sized potatoes
2 small onions
1 small tomato
4-5 cloves of garlic
Chilies as per preference
Salt to taste
Oil as required

Method
Skin and slice the potatoes in thin slices
Peel Onions and chop them 
Cut tomato in thin slices
Finely chop the garlic cloves
In a pan pour some water and drop in the sliced potatoes, onion, tomatoes and garlic pods. 
Add some oil to the pan, stir and allow it to simmer
Cover it with a lid and let it boil for about 10 minutes or till the potatoes are soft
Add slit green chilies to the pan
And immediately add small bits of cheese, you can even choose to add grated cheese so that it melts and dissolves faster.
Once the cheese has dissolve, give it a good stir to mix well 
You can choose to add more water if you don’t like it very thick.
